This '''woman''' was married to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]]. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], she and her [[Vidar Kim's first son|two]] [[Vidar Kim's second son|sons]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] accident over the city [[Kaadara]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
